title: Store Operations Supervisor
desc: Mengawasi operasional harian area ritel dan memastikan standar layanan tenant.
desc_en: Oversee daily retail operations and ensure tenant service standards.

title: Marketing Executive
desc: Menyusun dan menjalankan kampanye promosi serta acara mal.
desc_en: Plan and run promotional campaigns and mall events.

title: Customer Service Officer
desc: Melayani pengunjung dan anggota Privilege di meja informasi.
desc_en: Serve visitors and Privilege members at the information desk.

title: Building Engineer
desc: Menjaga sistem mekanikal dan elektrikal gedung agar berjalan andal.
desc_en: Keep the building mechanical and electrical systems running reliably.

title: Tenant Relations Officer
desc: Menjadi penghubung antara manajemen mal dan para tenant.
desc_en: Act as the link between mall management and tenants.
